sentences.en: He ran on and on, until he was completely exhausted.
sentences.zh: 他不停地跑啊跑，直到精疲力竭。

sentences.en: At last, I brought her exhausted body upon the beach.
sentences.zh: 最后，我将她疲惫不堪的身体抬上了沙滩。

sentences.en: I stood there for a while, watching the exhaust pipe.
sentences.zh: 我站在那里看了一会儿，看着排气管冒出的废气。

senses.zh: 弄空, 取出 - 用尽, 耗尽 - 使非常疲倦 -
排气装置, 排气管[孔] - 机器排出的废气
